title: The Classroom Barricade Begins to Fracture — Part 2

series.summary: Inside the locked school building, genius student Saya Takagi and bullied outcast Kohta Hirano take refuge inside a classroom. When Kohta clings to hope that the police or Self-Defense Forces will arrive, Saya bluntly crushes his optimism. She calculates that across Japan's population of 130 million, emergency responders will quickly be overwhelmed and infected themselves. Their grim debate is shattered by horrifying screams in the corridor outside, where students and teachers are dragged down and slaughtered against the frosted classroom windows. As bloody handprints smear the glass and the infected pound violently against their barricade, Saya and Kohta realize they must fight or be devoured.

segments.voiceover_text: Down inside the school, genius student Saya Takagi and gun enthusiast Kohta Hirano take refuge in a classroom. Kohta naively expects the police to save them.
Saya snaps that with Japan's population of one hundred thirty million, the police and army are powerless against an infectious collapse that turns responders into monsters.
Terrified screams suddenly erupt in the hallway. A fleeing student pounds frantically on the glass door before being dragged down into the darkness.
Blood splatters violently across the frosted window as the infected swarm. Shadows lunge against the barricade, clawing desperately to get inside.
